Merchant acquiring: volumes and margins in 2025

Merchant acquiring revenue grew 7.4% in 2025, according to the survey. Margins held steady.

Respondents pointed to pricing pressure from larger merchants, offset by growth in value-added services such as fraud screening and reporting.

This fictional article was prepared for a software demonstration.
